description: projects.createProjectEnv (POST /v10/projects/{idOrName}/env) carries a constraint-only inner anyOf ([{required:[target]},{required:[customEnvironmentIds]}]) on both oneOf arms (single env object, and the batch array's items). The converter's union pass sees that anyOf before the object properties, converts both constraint-only branches to Document, and the whole body degrades to unknown. Strip the inner anyOf from both arms so the body types as the proper env object (key/value/type/target/gitBranch/comment/customEnvironmentIds) and its batch-array form; the target-or-customEnvironmentIds requirement is enforced server-side.
